'''H1-R1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used by the [[Eternal Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]] capable of recordkeeping purposes.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
H1-R1 appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the mission "An Error in Alliance Records." The mission was available for [[Alliance Commander|players]] who romanced [[Lana Beniko]] to allow the player to clarify their relationship status because of a bug that caused the game to not reflect their relationship accurately.<ref name="SWTOR" />
